summary: CapsoVision's capsule endoscopy devices depend on a narrow set of CMOS image sensor suppliers (Sony/Samsung/Hynix), creating single-source fragility. The company faces concentration risk in both upstream inputs and downstream GI procedure volumes, with limited product diversification. Near-term stability hinges on sensor supply continuity and reimbursement trends.

inputs.concentration: High (3 global suppliers, medical-grade adds barriers)
inputs.fragility: High (single-source risk; any disruption halts production)

inputs.whyNeeded: Power for capsule operation and wireless transmission
inputs.fragility: Medium (alternative suppliers exist but require re-qualification)

inputs.fragility: Medium (long lead times, but multiple foundries possible)

Geopolitical or logistics shock could halt output
